530ba3a7f9cd: Salesforce Timesheet Calendar: Log Time by Project
5a3fa9424415: A Salesforce timesheet calendar on the Dates & Times component: people log hours by project as Time Entry records on their weekly Time Sheet, add split shifts and extra days, mark time billable or non-billable, total the week with formula and roll-up fields, and managers approve in bulk. No code.
d22b8fbe8ee1: How do I build a timesheet in Salesforce?
719a92a930ac: Create a weekly Time Sheet object and a Time Entry object in a master-detail relationship to it, with a date, a start time, an end time, a status and a project. Put the MultiDatePick Dates & Times calendar on the Time Sheet record page with the Weekly Time Sheet config, and every block of time a person drags saves as a Time Entry under that sheet.
b65a9203a68e: Can I add a second shift to a day that already has time logged?
af706a7858bf: Yes. Pick the day again: its logged blocks show as taken in the time grid, and a new block, such as an evening on call, saves as one more Time Entry. Extra days are added the same way. Max Bookings per Day sets how many separate blocks a person can pick on one day.
1c7e37485772: How do I total timesheet hours in Salesforce?
200b9be0f600: Add an Hours formula to the Time Entry, (End_Time__c - Start_Time__c) / 3600000, and a Roll-Up Summary on the Time Sheet that sums it. Filtered roll-ups give Approved Hours, Billable Hours and Non-billable Hours.
7b2cb612e90f: How do I separate billable and non-billable hours?
80f57b78a824: Add a Billing picklist to the Time Entry and set it as the calendar's Second Picklist Field. People choose Billable or Non-billable while logging time, it shows on every entry, and two filtered roll-ups total each kind.
